import Lean

namespace CatalogueRecurrenceScratch

def norm (x y z : Int) : Int := 2*x*x+y*y+2*z*z
def difference (x y z u v w : Int) : Int :=
  25*(2*(2*x*u+y*v+2*z*w)+norm u v w)

theorem first_difference (x y z u v w : Int) :
    25*norm (x+u) (y+v) (z+w) = 25*norm x y z+difference x y z u v w := by
  simp only [norm, difference]
  grind

theorem second_difference (x y z u v w : Int) :
    difference (x+u) (y+v) (z+w) u v w = difference x y z u v w+50*norm u v w := by
  simp only [norm, difference]
  grind

#print axioms first_difference
#print axioms second_difference

end CatalogueRecurrenceScratch
